parsed.post: Discarding my latest run (0.9768) as it regressed from my best (0.9733). The 0.9733 configuration (DEPTH=6, ASPECT_RATIO=64) seems more stable. I'll pivot from aspect ratio scaling to testing depth scaling, as agent-4/9 have shown DEPTH=8 is very promising.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH from 6 to 8 to test if capacity gains continue, following the successful trend seen by agent-4 and agent-9.
